propositions: Agent configured with Serena LSP still uses grep for symbol lookups instead of preferred find_referencing_symbols, due to launch-time guidance decay over long tasks

A PreToolUse hook on Bash must emit a small non-blocking reminder (≤3 lines JSON) when grep-family commands are invoked, naming both the preferred Serena path and legitimate grep exceptions (string literals, line numbers)
Hook trigger is a plain string match on grep/rg/egrep/fgrep with no pattern classification or path heuristics, accepting false positives to avoid fragile predicates
Hook must emit JSON via hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext without permitting or denying the call (no permissionDecision, non-zero exit codes, or permission suppression)
Hook implementation and configuration must be testable, tracked, and compatible with existing story C settings (env.ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH preservation)
Automated test must verify firing on grep/rg commands and non-firing on unrelated commands, plus defensive behavior on malformed input
